weak_references.why: owner: a capability that passes every gate is never withheld for a weaker reference (2026-10-23)

detail.elx_adc_enob: the same standard expression evaluated as a numpy polynomial
detail.elx_bjt_current_relations: the currents read from a netlist with a transistor model (the model itself is IC = beta IB)
detail.elx_capacitor_filter_ripple: the ripple as the integral of a constant discharge current and the RMS of the sawtooth by quadrature (the same small-ripple model)
detail.elx_drift_current: Ohm's law for the bar (conductance sigma A / L) instead of the field and drift velocity
detail.elx_einstein_diffusion: the same relations evaluated with scipy.constants and numpy
detail.elx_hartley_oscillator: the coil matrix summed as a quadratic form and the resonance by root finding (the same lumped model)
detail.elx_led_series_resistor: the resistor found by root finding on the current of the netlist (supply, resistor, LED sources)
detail.elx_linear_regulator_efficiency: the power balance read from a netlist of the regulator (the same model)
detail.elx_metastability_mtbf: the same expression evaluated in base-10 logarithms with numpy
detail.elx_mosfet_body_effect: the same model written through the depletion charge with numpy
detail.elx_opamp_integrator: the capacitor current integrated by quadrature (the same ideal model)
detail.elx_rectifier_averages: PIV is the published table for each circuit (the averages and angle are integrated independently)
detail.elx_sallen_key_equal_component_design: the resistor and gain found by root finding on the netlist's f0 and Q
detail.elx_sample_hold_droop: the droop integrated by quadrature and the hold limit by root finding (the same constant-current model)
detail.elx_semiconductor_conductivity: the same definition evaluated as a numpy dot product with scipy's elementary charge
detail.elx_setup_hold_timing: the same timing equations written as arrival and required event times (f_max by root finding)
detail.elx_shockley_diode_current: the same equation evaluated in 30-digit mpmath
detail.elx_slew_rate_limit: the sine's steepest slope by a complex-step derivative and the limits by root finding
detail.elx_thermal_voltage: the same definition evaluated with scipy.constants
detail.elx_transition_frequency: the -3 dB point of the single-pole current gain found by root finding (the same model)
detail.elx_zener_series_resistor_design: the resistor found by root finding on the worst-case Zener current; the powers then follow by the same products
